chapter: Armstrong, Parker and life inside the Basie band
title: Why the Army wanted Lester Young and Jo Jones, and how they passed
summary: Draft officials wanted to make an example of the pair; Prez's hip talk amused the examiners.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: I don't know how Basie beat the Army. Let me see, how did he beat the Army? I think he had spinal meningitis or something one time and --
Why were they so adamant about getting Jo and Prez?

Because they were mad with them, see, and they were going to try to make an example out of them because they had draft-dodged, you know, so long, see, for about a year. They didn't find -- they didn't know where they were.
You mentioned before that Jo already had a reputation for being crazy.

Yeah, well, I told him, I says, "They don't want Jo, Basie, because he's crazy. You know how Jo goes." I worked with Jo ten, eleven years. Actually, I worked with Jo twelve years and I've never understood one thing he'd start to say out of the twelve years -- I don't know what the hell he means, you know? And if anybody should know him, I should. But he goes on and on and on, you know, and I don't ever know what Jo was talking about, really.

So -- but shit, man, they passed with flying colors, man. So Prez went down there talking his hep talk, "Well, voodaroony," says, "I see you all got Von Hangman eyes. So I'm going to have to play my role." So they tell me Jo Jones said they asked, "What is this guy? Has this guy got German in him?" You know, he was talking about Von Hangman --

-- and voodaroony. Prez cracked them up. But that's the way a lot of musicians -- but they got hip to them. They got hip. You know what they started doing, Gary? They started keeping them overnight. They had a bed for the ones -- like them come in the heart like downs and the pressure was way up and stuff like that. They got hip, they found out what they were doing, so they just let them sleep overnight, (unintelligible). They wouldn't let them go back home and they got hip and when they'd come down to normal, they'd be in good health.
